## Combo 2556-3542-6485
Cards: Rally the Galadhrim + Palinchron + Mnemonic Wall
Color identity: GU | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 3 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite untap of lands you control; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite storm count; Infinite magecraft triggers; Infinite tapped copies of creatures you control
Start: Rally the Galadhrim (hand); Palinchron (battlefield); Mnemonic Wall (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
Steps: Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
  Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Mnemonic Wall and Palinchron, targeting Mnemonic Wall
  Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Palinchron.
  Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
  When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
  Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
  When the Mnemonic Wall token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
  Repeat, tapping the Mnemonic Wall and Palinchron tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

Steps: Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
  Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Mnemonic Wall and Famished Worldsire.

  An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

Produces: Win the game

  Resolve the first Biovisionary trigger, causing you to win the game.

  Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
  Repeat.
Notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Shipwreck Dowser and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

## Combo 4215-5256-6730

Color identity: GU | Bracket: 3-4+ (Spicy) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite mill; Infinite self-mill; Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers
Start: Sin, Unending Cataclysm (battlefield); Verdant Succession (battlefield); Altar of Dementia (battlefield)
Steps: Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sin.
  When Sin dies, it and Verdant Succession trigger.
  Resolve the Sin trigger, moving any counters from it onto another creature you control, and then shuffling Sin into your library.

  Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
  Repeat.
Notes: In order to get infinite +1/+1 counters, remove as many counters as possible when Sin enters, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin as it enters. Those counters can then be moved to another creature when Sin dies.

Color identity: GU | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 6 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {5}{G}{U}{U}{U} each turn
Produces: Near-infinite turns; Lock
Start: Lumra, Bellow of the Woods (battlefield); Walk the Aeons (hand); Lilysplash Mentor (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You control at least three Islands.

  Repeat each turn.

  Altanak triggers that many times, causing an opponent to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
